asked.item: where to get current price per 1000 credits from the API

verdict.reason: The Credits page says the current price comes from Get Credit Balance in pricePer1000CreditsUsd.

steps.text: Call Get Credit Balance, which is GET /v2/credits.
Read the current price from the pricePer1000CreditsUsd field, which is the price in US dollars per 1,000 credits, since pricing changes over time.
